headline: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back a shared robots.txt AI-training preference
summary: On 2026-10-30, OpenAI, Google and Microsoft announced plans or support for a shared robots.txt signal for website operators to express preferences about using content for generative-AI training. Anthropic draft author Kevin Kelley separately reported that Anthropic had started implementing the signal, while saying rollout across services would take time. The mechanism is described in an individual IETF Internet-Draft that is not endorsed by IETF and has no formal standing in its standards process. No provider conformance, publisher outcome, or resulting change in content collection or training data has been observed.
